name: Shuttle Flight
placementTarget: Rulebook slot H, the blank box at the top of the right column, above Other Actions.
summary: Shuttle Flight. Move from any haven or supply center to any other haven or supply center on the grid. The letter H is the rulebook slot named in the manifest. It is not printed on the sticker.

mechanics.timing: Action. Rule slot H sits with the actions, above Other Actions. The sticker does not say it is free.
mechanics.effect: Move from any haven or supply center to any other haven or supply center on the grid.
restrictions: The origin must be a haven or a supply center.
The destination must be a different haven or supply center on the grid.
No card discard and no supply-cube cost is printed.
The recon report's landing-strip and runway story is the reason for this action. It adds no separate build step on this sticker.
